pr_body: Fix #10388 This PR adds a status icon for every branch which has a status check for the latest commit on branch list page.
pr_comments: Separare column in the UI may be nice, but this table needs to be rewritten later, so I guess this position is ok until then.

> Separare column in the UI may be nice, but this table needs to be rewritten later, so I guess this position is ok until then.

That's the way we do it on commits list, so I also think we can stay with it for now.
